name: Zutto Issho CD-ROM Collection -Ukiuki Chika-chan-
original_name: ずっといっしょ CD-ROM COLLECTION -うきうき智香ちゃん-
source:
Fandisc contains three pieces:

1. Original tiny novel Spring is the best 「『春一番』」
2. Dress-up game Sound of silver 「白銀の音」
3. Blackjack mini-game The longest day of Marui High School「丸井高校の一番長い日」
